title: Minimum String Length After Removing Substrings
summary: Given a string s made of uppercase English letters, you can remove any occurrence of the substrings 'AB' or 'CD'.
statement: Given a string s made of uppercase English letters, you can remove any occurrence of the substrings 'AB' or 'CD'. After performing these operations, find the shortest possible length of the remaining string.
constraints: Repeatedly remove any contiguous occurrence of AB or CD.
Removals may expose new removable pairs.
Return the minimum possible remaining string length.
hints: Scan left to right with a stack representing the irreducible processed prefix.
When the top plus current character is AB or CD, pop it; otherwise push current.
A removal can interact only with the new boundary at the stack top, which the next step checks automatically.
Every removed pair is legal, and an irreducible stack contains no legal pair; local cancellation is confluent for these disjoint pair endings.
editorial: Every removed pair is legal, and an irreducible stack contains no legal pair; local cancellation is confluent for these disjoint pair endings.
